theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_fli_unit_disc_mass_eventually
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), 0 < θ₀ → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ a ∈ (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → (W k).weight (closedBall a 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((θ₀ + η) * (unitBallVolume n).toReal)
